full_name: Christina L. Davis | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Social Sciences Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor Harvard University
bio: Christina L. Davis is the Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor at the Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study, a professor of government in the Harvard Faculty of Arts and Sciences, and the director of the Program on U.S.-Japan Relations at Harvard. She specializes in international relations with a focus on the politics of trade.
